15.odr_com: Hadar, and Thema, and Iethur, and Naphis, and Cedma.
15.sabates_a: Hadar, and Thema, and Iethur, and Naphis, and Cedma.
15.madueke_b: Hadar, and Thema, and Iethur, and Naphis, and Cedma.

16.s_dismas: Theſe are the ſonnes of Iſmael: and theſe are their names by their caſtles and townes, twelue princes of their tribes.
16.odr_com: These are the sonnes of Ismael: and these are their names by their castles and townes, twelue princes of their tribes.
16.sabates_a: These are the sons of Ismael: and these are their names by their castles and towns, twelve Princes of their tribes.
16.madueke_b: These are the sons of Ismael: and these are their names by their castles and towns, twelve Princes of their tribes.

17.s_dismas: And the yeares of Iſmaels life came to an hundred thirtie ſeauen, and decaying died, and was put vnto his people.
17.odr_com: And the yeares of Ismaels life came to an hundred thirtie seauen, and decaying died, and was put vnto his people.
17.sabates_a: And the years of Ismael's life came to an hundred thirty seven, and decaying died, and was put unto his people.
17.madueke_b: And the years of Ismael's life came to an hundred thirty seven, and decaying died, and was put unto his people.

18.s_dismas: And he dwelt from Heuila euen to Sur, which looketh towards Ægypt, as they enter to the Aſſirians, before the face of al his bretheren died he.
18.odr_com: And he dwelt from Heuila euen to Sur, which looketh towards Ægypt, as they enter to the Assirians, before the face of al his bretheren died he.
18.sabates_a: And he dwelt from Hevila even to Sur, which looketh towards Ægypt, as they enter to the Assyrians, before the face of all his brethren died he.
18.madueke_b: And he dwelt from Hevila even to Sur, which looketh towards Aegypt, as they enter to the Assyrians, before the face of all his brethren died he.

19.s_dismas: Theſe alſo are the generations of Iſaac the ſonne of Abraham: Abraham begat Iſaac:
19.odr_com: These also are the generations of Isaac the sonne of Abraham: Abraham begat Isaac:
19.sabates_a: These also are the generations of Isaac the son of Abraham: Abraham begat Isaac:
19.madueke_b: These also are the generations of Isaac the son of Abraham: Abraham begat Isaac:

20.s_dismas: who when he was fortie yeares old, tooke to wife Rebecca the daughter of Bathuel the Syrian of Meſopotamia, ſiſter to Laban.
20.odr_com: who when he was fortie yeares old, tooke to wife Rebecca the daughter of Bathuel the Syrian of Mesopotamia, sister to Laban.
20.sabates_a: Who when he was forty years old, took to wife Rebecca the daughter of Bathuel the Syrian of Mesopotamia, sister to Laban.
20.madueke_b: Who when he was forty years old, took to wife Rebecca the daughter of Bathuel the Syrian of Mesopotamia, sister to Laban.

21.s_dismas: And Iſaac beſought our Lord for his wife, becauſe ſhe was barren: who heard him, and made Rebecca to conceaue.
21.odr_com: And Isaac besought our Lord for his wife, because she was barren: who heard him, and made Rebecca to conceaue.
21.sabates_a: And Isaac besought our Lord for his wife, because she was barren: who heard him, and made Rebecca to conceive.
21.madueke_b: And Isaac besought our Lord for his wife, because she was barren: who heard him, and made Rebecca to conceive.

22.s_dismas: But the little ones ſtrugled in her wombe; who ſaid: If it ſhould be ſo with me, what nede was there to conceaue? And ſhe went to conſult our Lord.
22.odr_com: But the little ones strugled in her wombe; who said: If it should be so with me, what nede was there to conceaue? And she went to consult our Lord.
22.sabates_a: But the little ones struggled in her womb; who said: If it should be so with me, what need was there to conceive? And she went to consult our Lord.
22.madueke_b: But the little ones struggled in her womb; who said: If it should be so with me, what need was there to conceive? And she went to consult our Lord.

23.s_dismas: Who anſwering ſaid: Two nations are in thy wombe, and two peoples ſhal be diuided out of thy wombe, and one people ſhal ouercome the other, and the elder ſhal ſerue the younger.
23.odr_com: Who answering said: Two nations are in thy wombe, and two peoples shal be diuided out of thy wombe, and one people shal ouercome the other, and the elder shal serue the younger.
23.sabates_a: Who answering said: Two nations are in thy womb, and two peoples shall be divided out of thy womb, and one people shall overcome the other, and the elder shall serve the younger.
23.madueke_b: Who answering said: Two nations are in thy womb, and two peoples shall be divided out of thy womb, and one people shall overcome the other, and the elder shall serve the younger.

24.s_dismas: Now her time was come to be deliuered, and behold twinnes were found in her wombe.
24.odr_com: Now her time was come to be deliuered, and behold twinnes were found in her wombe.
24.sabates_a: Now her time was come to be delivered, and behold twins were found in her womb.
24.madueke_b: Now her time was come to be delivered, and behold twins were found in her womb.

25.s_dismas: He that came forth firſt, was read, and al hearie in manner of a skinne: and his name was called Eſau. Immediatly the other coming forth, held his brothers plant in his hand: and therfore he called him Iacob.
25.odr_com: He that came forth first, was read, and al hearie in manner of a skinne: and his name was called Esau. Immediatly the other coming forth, held his brothers plant in his hand: and therfore he called him Iacob.
25.sabates_a: He that came forth first, was red, and all hairy in manner of a skin: and his name was called Esau. Immediately the other coming forth, held his brother's plant in his hand: and therefore he called him Jacob.
25.madueke_b: He that came forth first, was red, and all hairy in manner of a skin: and his name was called Esau. Immediately the other coming forth, held his brother's plant in his hand: and therefore he called him Jacob.

26.s_dismas: Threeſcore yeares old was Iſaac, when the litle ones were borne vnto him.
26.odr_com: Threescore yeares old was Isaac, when the litle ones were borne vnto him.
26.sabates_a: Threescore years old was Isaac, when the little ones were born unto him.
26.madueke_b: Threescore years old was Isaac, when the little ones were born unto him.

27.s_dismas: Who being growne vp, Eſau became a man cunning in hunting, and a huſband man: but Iacob a plaine man dwelled in tents.
27.odr_com: Who being growne vp, Esau became a man cunning in hunting, and a husband man: but Iacob a plaine man dwelled in tents.
27.sabates_a: Who being grown up, Esau became a man cunning in hunting, & a husband man: but Jacob a plain man dwelled in tents:
27.madueke_b: Who being grown up, Esau became a man cunning in hunting, & a husband man: but Jacob a plain man dwelled in tents:

28.s_dismas: Iſaac loued Eſau, becauſe he did eate of his hunting: and Rebecca loued Iacob.
28.odr_com: Isaac loued Esau, because he did eate of his hunting: and Rebecca loued Iacob.
28.sabates_a: Isaac loved Esau, because he did eat of his hunting: and Rebecca loved Jacob.
28.madueke_b: Isaac loved Esau, because he did eat of his hunting: and Rebecca loved Jacob.

29.s_dismas: And Iacob boyled broth: to whom Eſau being come faynt out of the field,
29.odr_com: And Iacob boyled broth: to whom Esau being come faynt out of the field,
29.sabates_a: & Jacob boiled broth: to whom Esau being come faint out of the field,
29.madueke_b: & Jacob boiled broth: to whom Esau being come faint out of the field,

30.s_dismas: ſaid: Geue me of this read broth, becauſe I am exceding faint. For which cauſe his name was called Edom.
30.odr_com: said: Geue me of this read broth, because I am exceding faint. For which cause his name was called Edom.
30.sabates_a: said: Give me of this red broth, because I am exceeding faint. For which cause his name was called Edom.
30.madueke_b: said: Give me of this red broth, because I am exceeding faint. For which cause his name was called Edom.

31.s_dismas: To whom Iacob ſaid: Sel me thy firſt-birthright.
31.odr_com: To whom Iacob said: Sel me thy first-birth-right.
31.sabates_a: To whom Jacob said: sell me thy first-birth-right.
31.madueke_b: To whom Jacob said: sell me thy first-birth-right.

32.s_dismas: He anſwered, Loe I dye, what wil the firſt birth right auaile me?
32.odr_com: He answered, Loe I dye, what wil the first birth right auaile me?
32.sabates_a: He answered, Lo I die, what will the first-birth-right avail me?
32.madueke_b: He answered, Lo I die, what will the first-birth-right avail me?

33.s_dismas: Iacob ſaid: Sweare therfore to me. Eſau ſware to him, and ſould his firſt-birth-right.
33.odr_com: Iacob said: Sweare therfore to me. Esau sware to him, and sould his first-birth-right.
33.sabates_a: Jacob said: Swear therefore to me. Esau sware to him, and sold his first-birth-right.
33.madueke_b: Jacob said: Swear therefore to me. Esau sware to him, and sold his first-birth-right.

34.s_dismas: And ſo taking bread and the rice broth, did eate, and drinke, and went his way; little eſteeming that he had ſold his firſt birth right.
34.odr_com: And so taking bread and the rice broth, did eate, and drinke, and went his way; little esteeming that he had sold his first birth right.
34.sabates_a: And so taking bread and the rice broth, did eat, and drink, and went his way; little esteeming that he had sold his first-birth-right.
34.madueke_b: And so taking bread and the rice broth, did eat, and drink, and went his way; little esteeming that he had sold his first-birth-right.

janvier_by_verse.1: And Abraham married another wife named Cetura:
janvier_by_verse.2: Which bare him Zamran, and Jecsan, and Madan, and Madian, and Jesboc, and Sue.
janvier_by_verse.3: Jecsan also begat Saba & Dadan. The Children of Dadan were Assurim, and Latusim, and Loomim.
janvier_by_verse.4: But also of Madian was born Epha, and Opher, and Henoch, and Abida, and Eldaa: all these were the children of Cetura.
janvier_by_verse.5: And Abraham gave all his possessions to Isaac:
janvier_by_verse.6: and to the children of his concubines he gave gifts, and separated them from Isaac his son, whilst himself yet lived, to the east country.
janvier_by_verse.7: And the days of Abraham's life were an hundred seventy and five years.
janvier_by_verse.8: And decaying died in a good old age, and having lived a great time, and being full of days and was gathered to his people.
janvier_by_verse.9: And there buried him Isaac and Ismael his sons in the double cave, which was situated in the field of Ephron the son of Seor the Hethite, over-against Mambre,
janvier_by_verse.10: which he had bought of the children of Heth: there was he buried, and Sara his wife.
janvier_by_verse.11: And after his death God blessed Isaac his son, who dwelled beside the well of the Living & Seeing, so named.
janvier_by_verse.12: These are the generations of Ismael the son of Abraham, whom Agar the Ægyptian bare him, Sara's servant: &
janvier_by_verse.13: These are the names of his children according to their calling and generations. The first begotten of Ishmael Nabajoth, then Cedar, and Adbeel, and Mabsam,
janvier_by_verse.14: Masma also, and Duma, and Massa,
janvier_by_verse.15: Hadar, and Thema, and Iethur, and Naphis, and Cedma.
janvier_by_verse.16: These are the sons of Ismael: and these are their names by their castles and towns, twelve Princes of their tribes.
janvier_by_verse.17: And the years of Ismael's life came to an hundred thirty seven, and decaying died, and was put unto his people.
janvier_by_verse.18: And he dwelt from Hevila even to Sur, which looketh towards Ægypt, as they enter to the Assyrians, before the face of all his brethren died he.
janvier_by_verse.19: These also are the generations of Isaac the son of Abraham: Abraham begat Isaac:
janvier_by_verse.20: Who when he was forty years old, took to wife Rebecca the daughter of Bathuel the Syrian of Mesopotamia, sister to Laban.
janvier_by_verse.21: And Isaac besought our Lord for his wife, because she was barren: who heard him, and made Rebecca to conceive.
janvier_by_verse.22: But the little ones struggled in her womb; who said: If it should be so with me, what need was there to conceive? And she went to consult our Lord.
janvier_by_verse.23: Who answering said: Two nations are in thy womb, and two peoples shall be divided out of thy womb, and one people shall overcome the other, and the elder shall serve the younger.
janvier_by_verse.24: Now her time was come to be delivered, and behold twins were found in her womb.
janvier_by_verse.25: He that came forth first, was red, and all hairy in manner of a skin: and his name was called Esau. Immediately the other coming forth, held his brother's plant in his hand: and therefore he called him Jacob.
janvier_by_verse.26: Threescore years old was Isaac, when the little ones were born unto him.
janvier_by_verse.27: Who being grown up, Esau became a man cunning in hunting, & a husband man: but Jacob a plain man dwelled in tents:
janvier_by_verse.28: Isaac loved Esau, because he did eat of his hunting: and Rebecca loved Jacob.
janvier_by_verse.29: & Jacob boiled broth: to whom Esau being come faint out of the field,
janvier_by_verse.30: said: Give me of this red broth, because I am exceeding faint. For which cause his name was called Edom.
janvier_by_verse.31: To whom Jacob said: sell me thy first-birth-right.
janvier_by_verse.32: He answered, Lo I die, what will the first-birth-right avail me?
janvier_by_verse.33: Jacob said: Swear therefore to me. Esau sware to him, and sold his first-birth-right.
janvier_by_verse.34: And so taking bread and the rice broth, did eat, and drink, and went his way; little esteeming that he had sold his first-birth-right.
